name: Scourge Invasion: Revanchion fights with his SmartAI abilities
contract: Revanchion (14690) is the Scourge Invasion boss the event places in Dire Maul. His smart_scripts rows cast
Shadow Bolt Volley (15245) every 12.5-14 s from 10-15 s into combat and Frost Nova (14907) every 14-18 s from
13-16 s, but creature_template left his AIName empty, so the rows never ran and he fought with melee alone.
Expected: engaged by a level 60 player, he roots the player with his own Frost Nova within the first 25
seconds of the fight. Shadow Bolt Volley leaves no aura to read and is not asserted separately.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Revanchion roots the player with Frost Nova
